brandDocs.title: Positioning
brandDocs.body:
Proposed direction, not yet confirmed by the client.

The line: one clear sentence about who this creator is and why people follow.

brandDocs.title: Content pillars
brandDocs.body:
Draft, not yet confirmed by the client.

- Quick recipes: 40%
- Eating out: 30%
- Everyday life: 30%

brandDocs.title: Reel series
brandDocs.body:
Named series build habit. People follow for the next episode.

Example series: a weekly recipe in under 60 seconds.

brandDocs.title: Voice
brandDocs.body: Warm, direct and a little playful. Scripts should sound like the creator talking, not like a brand.

brandDocs.title: Weekly rhythm and what to track
brandDocs.body:
Three reels and one carousel a week.

Track saves, shares, non-follower reach and profile visits to follows.

brandDocs.title: Feed aesthetic
brandDocs.body: Same cover style for each series, so a series is recognisable in the grid.
